name: Yogi
description: Yogi connects Claude to what your consumers are actually saying. Ask questions about your brands and products, and get instant answers with real consumer feedback — ratings and reviews, support tickets, social chatter, and more — all analyzed at the sentence level by Yogi's insights engine. Diagnose the why behind an issue, benchmark products against competitors, validate claims and trends. Answer the CEO's question in seconds, grounded in consumer truth.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Yogi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yogi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.meetyogi.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yogi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yogi provides these MCP tools: aggregate_and_group_by, create_chart, get_analysis_context, get_verbatims, list_projects, lookup_filter_options, and select_project.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yogi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Yogi in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Yogi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yogi is developed by Yogi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
